content.comment_body: Dear [product_name] Support, I have a question regarding deploying [product_name] on AWS. Following the instructions, my [product_name] project was successfully deployed to AWS. Afterwards, on Elastic Beanstalk, I received the following error message: 100% of requests are returning HTTP 4xx errors. The request rate (12 requests/min) is insufficient to assess application health. ELB processes are not healthy on all instances, and ELB health is failing or unavailable everywhere. I'm unsure whether the issue originates from my [product_name] device configuration or if I need to adjust something in the policy settings, or elsewhere. Could you assist? Thank you.

Hello [user_name], This matter can be forwarded to the [company_name] Support Team for dedicated, complimentary assistance. Please visit your personal area in "My Forum" for details about our individual support offers. Regards, [product_name] Support

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced problems deploying a [product_name] project to AWS Elastic Beanstalk, encountering consistent HTTP 4xx errors and unhealthy ELB status on all instances. The user is unsure if the cause is related to their device settings or AWS policies, leading to confusion over where to focus troubleshooting efforts.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a smooth deployment process for their [product_name] project on AWS, with clear guidance on solving deployment errors and an understanding of whether adjustments are needed on the device or within AWS settings.
